exit: 0
--- stdout
Replay a vector set against a subject, or a commissioning spec against its trends, and print the receipt.

Stdout is the receipt when the run reaches a verdict: exit 0 when every scenario (with --commission, every compared output) passed, 1 when one failed or the run checked nothing. Anything that prevents a verdict is exit 2 with the JSON report. With --out the receipt goes to DIR/receipt.json and the report to stdout.

Usage: oce verify [OPTIONS] --subject <SUBJECT> <VECTORS>
       oce verify [OPTIONS] --commission <SPEC>

Arguments:
  [VECTORS]
          The vector set (`oce/vectors/v1`); mutant paths resolve against its directory

Options:
      --render <RENDER>
          When to write a human-readable rendering of the report to stderr
          
          [default: auto]
          [possible values: auto, always, never]

      --subject <SUBJECT>
          The sequence the vectors check: CXF (`.jsonld`, `.cxf.json`), text (`.oce`) or wire (`.json`)

      --subject-form <SUBJECT_FORM>
          The subject's form; overrides the name
          
          [possible values: cxf, text, wire]

      --commission <SPEC>
          Run a commissioning spec (`oce/commissioning-spec/v1`, OBC §12.7) instead of a vector set: its CXF, mapping and trend files resolve against the directory of SPEC as given and may not leave it

      --reference <N>
          The zero-based index of the spec's reference to run; needed when it has several

      --out <DIR>
          Write the receipt to DIR/receipt.json (atomically) and print the report on stdout; with --commission also each output's exceedance curve, `DIR/outputs/<k>/errors.csv`. DIR/receipt.json must be absent or a regular file (never a link) and no file the run reads

      --bounds
          With --commission and --out: also each Real output's reference, test and bound curves beside its errors.csv, under pyfunnel's names

      --data <DATA>
          With --commission: what the trend files are, the receipt's data label (trended when absent)
          
          [possible values: trended, synthetic]

      --require-mutants-caught
          Exit 1 when a mutant survived or the set lists none; no receipt byte changes

      --deny-warnings
          Exit 1 when the subject warned at load or a scenario left a warning unmatched (with --commission: any load or run-time warning); no receipt byte changes

      --timings
          Measure the run into the receipt's timings, which receipt_id never covers

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version
--- stderr
